name: print-social-spring-sale-posts-sky-blue-and-charcoal-with-vertical-type
title: Spring sale pack in sky blue and charcoal with vertical condensed titles and leaf sprigs
whatItIs: Four square posts with photos of a couple in denim against a sky-blue backdrop, white and charcoal panels with sky-blue condensed titles ('SPRING SALE', 'BEST DEALS') set vertically or horizontally, italic '/up to 50% off' notes and thin leaf-branch illustrations in corners.
whatItMeans: Cool and stylish; matching the type colour to the studio backdrop unifies photo and graphics.
techniques: Match type colour to the photo backdrop.
Rotate condensed titles to run vertically.
Alternate light and dark panels across a set.
Tuck fine leaf sprigs into corners.

vocabulary.definition: Text rotated to read bottom to top.
Repeating a photo's colour in graphics.
